datasets.name: capacity_prices
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, guests, guests_order, listings, valid_price_listings, median_price_gbp
FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.v_capacity_prices
ORDER BY guests_order, city_name

datasets.name: city_comparison
queryLines:
SELECT metric_order, metric, unit, city_name, value, reference_value,
       difference_vs_reference, pct_difference_vs_reference
FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.v_city_comparison
ORDER BY metric_order, city_name

datasets.name: city_overview
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, snapshot_date, total_listings, valid_price_listings, price_coverage_pct,
       median_price_gbp, mean_price_gbp, median_availability_365, avg_review_score,
       review_listings, distinct_hosts, listings_per_host, entire_home_share_pct, neighbourhoods
FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.v_city_overview
ORDER BY total_listings DESC

datasets.name: error_by_neighbourhood
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, model_version, segment AS neighbourhood, evaluated_listings, model_mae_gbp,
       mean_signed_error_gbp, median_actual_price_gbp
FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.v_model_error_segments
WHERE segment_type = 'neighbourhood' AND evaluated_listings >= 20
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city_name, model_version, pipeline_version
                           ORDER BY model_mae_gbp DESC) <= 10
ORDER BY city_name, model_mae_gbp DESC

datasets.name: error_by_room_type
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, model_version, segment AS room_type, evaluated_listings, model_mae_gbp,
       baseline_mae_gbp, mean_signed_error_gbp, under_priced_share_pct
FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.v_model_error_segments
WHERE segment_type = 'room_type'
ORDER BY city_name, model_mae_gbp DESC

datasets.name: largest_errors
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, model_version, pricing_direction, listing_id, room_type, neighbourhood,
       accommodates, actual_price_gbp, predicted_price_gbp, model_error_gbp, model_pct_error
FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.v_model_predictions
WHERE in_evaluation_set AND model_evaluable AND pricing_direction IN ('under-priced', 'over-priced')
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city_name, model_version, pipeline_version, pricing_direction
                           ORDER BY ABS(model_error_gbp) DESC) <= 10
ORDER BY city_name, pricing_direction, ABS(model_error_gbp) DESC

datasets.name: model_mae
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, model_version, pipeline_version, evaluation_role,
       'Baseline: median by room type and guests' AS estimator,
       baseline_mae_gbp AS mae_gbp, baseline_evaluated_listings AS evaluated_listings
FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.v_model_performance
UNION ALL
SELECT city_name, model_version, pipeline_version, evaluation_role,
       'Model' AS estimator, model_mae_gbp AS mae_gbp, model_evaluated_listings AS evaluated_listings
FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.v_model_performance
ORDER BY city_name, estimator

datasets.name: model_performance
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, model_version, pipeline_version, evaluation_role, listings_in_set,
       prediction_coverage_pct, model_evaluated_listings, baseline_mae_gbp, model_mae_gbp,
       mae_improvement_gbp, mae_improvement_pct
FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.v_model_performance
ORDER BY model_version, evaluation_role, city_name

datasets.name: predicted_vs_actual
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, model_version, room_type, actual_price_gbp, predicted_price_gbp
FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.v_model_predictions
WHERE in_evaluation_set AND model_evaluable AND actual_price_gbp <= 1000

datasets.name: price_bands
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, price_band, band_order, listings, share_pct
FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.v_price_bands
ORDER BY band_order, city_name

datasets.name: room_type_mix
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, room_type, listings, share_pct, valid_price_listings, median_price_gbp
FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.v_room_type_mix
ORDER BY city_name, listings DESC

datasets.name: top_neighbourhoods
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, neighbourhood, median_price_gbp, valid_price_listings, listings, price_rank_in_city
FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.v_neighbourhood_prices
WHERE price_rank_in_city <= 10
ORDER BY city_name, price_rank_in_city

lines:
## London has 31 times more listings than Bristol, and its median night costs £175 against £130

Nightly advertised prices in GBP on the snapshot date. Price statistics use listings with a valid price only; about one in three London listings and nearly one in four Bristol listings advertise no price. Availability counts open calendar days and is not occupancy.

lines:
## Bristol is about a quarter cheaper than London and stays open roughly 50 more days a year

Differences are shown against London. Compare the same room type and guest capacity before reading the overall gap, because the cities differ in room-type composition and listing size.

frame.title: Same room type, different price level
Median price rises with guest capacity in both cities

lines:
## Model against baseline: replace this headline with the measured test-set MAE finding

Reported rows: held-out test split of London and Bristol, and every row of a transfer city. Error = predicted - actual; negative means the model under-prices. Baseline = training median for the same room type and guest capacity. After the third-city run, filter by model version to compare the first run with later changes.
